name: wx-vsce-claude-usage-ultra
description: Show Claude Code plan usage — 5-hour session window, weekly all-models and per-model windows, reset countdowns and extra-usage spend — in the VS Code status bar.

claudeUsageUltra.label.description: Text shown before the numbers, so the status bar item is recognisable. Leave empty for the icon alone.

enumDescriptions: 5-hour session window, percent used and time until it resets
7-day all-models window, percent used and time until it resets
Fullest per-model weekly window, percent used — for example Fable or Opus
Countdowns to the session and weekly resets, for windows not shown above — nothing is counted down twice
Extra usage credits spent this month

claudeUsageUltra.show.description: Segments to render in the status bar, in order.

claudeUsageUltra.noticeAtPercent.description: Mark a usage window with a yellow dot once it passes this percentage. Windows below it stay green. Set to 100 to drop this step.

claudeUsageUltra.warnAtPercent.description: Mark a usage window with an orange dot once it passes this percentage.

claudeUsageUltra.criticalAtPercent.description: Mark a usage window with a red dot once it passes this percentage. Claude Code's own critical windows always get one.

claudeUsageUltra.errorAtPercent.markdownDeprecationMessage: Renamed to `#claudeUsageUltra.criticalAtPercent#` — a full window is not an error. A value left here still applies until the new setting is set.

claudeUsageUltra.staleAfterMinutes.description: Mark the reading stale when this many minutes have passed since the last successful refresh.

claudeUsageUltra.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to ask the Claude Code CLI for plan usage. Each refresh runs the CLI briefly; failed refreshes back off automatically.

claudeUsageUltra.refreshOnFocus.description: Refresh when the window regains focus and the reading is over a minute old.

claudeUsageUltra.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up on a refresh if the Claude Code CLI has not answered within this many seconds.

claudeUsageUltra.claudePath.description: Path to the `claude` executable. Leave empty to use the CLI bundled with the Claude Code extension, then `~/.claude/local/claude`, then `claude` from PATH.

claudeUsageUltra.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to place the item on.

claudeUsageUltra.priority.description: Status bar item priority. Higher values sit further left within the chosen alignment.
